summary: Part II Items 13-17 Tax Withheld and Item 18 Total Taxes Withheld compute and print 0.00 even with ATC, Tax Base, and Tax Rate filled (verified by hand-editing Row 13 in the UI), and overflow ATC rows 6-7 do not print at all on this branch. On Page 2 Schedule 1, Total Taxes Withheld and Remitted (20,827,279.01) and Tax Rate (6) print left-aligned, TINs print undashed (14 raw digits) and both TIN and Name of Payees are shrunk to 5.6-7.0px by print-overrides/1600-pt-2018.css. Page 1 zero rows print 0.00 instead of blank and overremittance prints '-' inside the comb instead of parentheses; Page 2 omits Table 1 ATC reference.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 13-18 (Tax Withheld and Total Taxes Withheld) and Attachment rows 6-7
defects.what: All 5 printed Part II rows (Items 13-17) and both overflow rows (6-7) compute and print 0.00 in Tax Withheld and Item 18 Total Taxes Withheld even after hand-editing Row 13 Tax Base (248,501,750.50) at rate 3 in the form UI. Overflow ATC rows 6-7 are omitted from print on this branch (no continuation page emitted).

defects.what: Schedule 1 Total Taxes Withheld and Remitted (20,827,279.01) prints left-aligned instead of right-aligned (unlike the row amounts above it), and Column (6) Tax Rate ('3.00', '2.00') prints left-aligned flush against the left border with no '%' sign.

defects.where: Page 2, Schedule 1 Columns (2) TIN and (3) Name of Payees (#p2c16-i..#p2c45-i)
defects.what: Payee TINs print as 14 undashed digits ('00012345100000') instead of dashed format, and print-overrides/1600-pt-2018.css forces tiny 5.6-7.0px !important sizes on both TIN and Name of Payees.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 13-19, 22-27 (zero rows and overremittance)
defects.what: Zero/unused Part II money combs print '0 | . | 00' instead of blank, and negative/overremittance Items 22 and 27 print a leading '-' inside the comb instead of parentheses per the '(Overremittance)' caption.
Official Page 2 includes Table 1 (Alphanumeric Tax Code reference) below Schedule 1; the printed Page 2 omits Table 1 completely, leaving the bottom 65% blank.
